content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the MetricCollectorHAController not properly handling the scenario where the Helix cluster was not fully set up before attempting to add instances to it. The original implementation did not include a retry mechanism, leading to failures when trying to retrieve instances from the cluster or add new instances if the cluster was not ready. The patch introduced a retry loop with a delay, allowing the system to wait for the cluster to be fully initialized before proceeding with instance addition, thus preventing the AMS from stopping unexpectedly after a rolling upgrade.
